metadata.question: Did the area around Walvis Bay, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Walvis Bay, Namibia (approximately -22.9576°S, 14.5053°E) - Time periods: February 2021 vs February 2010-2020 average - Collection: Sentinel-2 (best for 2021), but need Landsat for 2010-2020 since Sentinel-2 only starts in 2015 - Use Landsat 8/9 for consistency across both periods 2. Masking strategy: - Question is about NDVI (vegetation), not clouds - Should mask clouds to get accurate NDVI values - Use cloud masking for both periods 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 - Zero or low NDVI is valid (desert/urban areas) - Check if results are None, NaN, or outside valid range - Compare: if 2021 NDVI > 2010-2020 average → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const walvisBay = ee.Geometry.Point([14.5053, -22.9576]); const region = walvisBay.buffer(10000); // 10km radius // 2. Cloud masking function for Landsat 8/9 function maskL8Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // Cloud shadow return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // 3. NDVI calculation function function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // 4. Data Acquisition - February 2021 let col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2021, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .map(maskL8Clouds) .map(addNDVI); const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2021 === 0) { // Try Landsat 9 col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2021, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .map(maskL8Clouds) .map(addNDVI); const size2021_L9 = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2021 Images (L9): ${size2021_L9}`); if (size2021_L9 === 0) { console.log("No data for February 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 5. Data Acquisition - February 2010-2020 average const col2010_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2010, 2020, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .map(maskL8Clouds) .map(addNDVI); const sizeBaseline = col2010_2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2010-2020 Images: ${sizeBaseline}`); if (sizeBaseline === 0) { console.log("No data for February 2010-2020."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 6. Calculate mean NDVI for 2021 const ndvi2021 = col2021.select('NDVI').mean(); const stats2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2021 = stats2021['NDVI_mean']; const count2021 = stats2021['NDVI_count']; console.log(`2021: Mean NDVI = ${mean2021}, Pixels = ${count2021}`); if (count2021 === 0 || count2021 === null) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2021 after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 7. Calculate mean NDVI for 2010-2020 const ndviBaseline = col2010_2020.select('NDVI').mean(); const statsBaseline = ndviBaseline.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanBaseline = statsBaseline['NDVI_mean']; const countBaseline = statsBaseline['NDVI_count']; console.log(`2010-2020: Mean NDVI = ${meanBaseline}, Pixels = ${countBaseline}`); if (countBaseline === 0 || countBaseline === null) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2010-2020 after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 8. Validation & Final Answer if (mean2021 === null || meanBaseline === null || isNaN(mean2021) || isNaN(meanBaseline) || mean2021 < -1 || mean2021 > 1 || meanBaseline < -1 || meanBaseline > 1) { console.log("Invalid NDVI calculation."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Difference: ${(mean2021 - meanBaseline).toFixed(4)}`); if (mean2021 > meanBaseline) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
